g.text: Combined daily totals: one read-only calculation
Four getters evaluated in constructor argument order
Each getter uses mapToLong(...).sum(); stream operations are condensed.
Empty meals give four zeros. Repeated references contribute on every occurrence.
This call changes no meals and retains no totals field; a new immutable result is returned.
The caller is an API client, not MealPlanViewer, which sums MealSummary values separately.
